summary: Pacific Oak Strategic Opportunity REIT, Inc. through subsidiaries entered a $216 million loan agreement to refinance existing property debt on a single-family rental portfolio. The loan, fully funded on May 8, 2026, refinanced existing financing, funded a $10M interest reserve, paid a 1.5% origination fee, and made a $4M distribution to PORT with up to $4M more in six months. Terms: one-month SOFR + 4.75% (floor 7.75%), interest-only, maturity August 8, 2027, with two six-month extensions. No board recommendation or advisor named. This liability management event replaces debt; watch the floating rate exposure and refinancing risk at maturity.
